path: prompts/漫剧/特效向/战斗大招/goodcase-seedance-exploring-south-indian-commercial-cinema-n--疾驰列车上的英雄决战.md
prompt:
Exploring South Indian commercial cinema, not just the action, but the hero’s style, attitude & mannerisms. 🔥

Then I thought… what if #Thalaivar @rajinikanth acted in a cartoon? 🎬😎

🎥 Powered by Seedance 2.5 in @higgsfield
 #Superstar #Rajinikanth

PROMPT 💥
Pack 1/2

【参考图使用规则】

basha 的外貌、发型、墨镜、黑衬衫与红色腰布严格参考角色资产图三；raghu 的外貌、发型、金框墨镜、紫红色花纹衬衫、金链与 R 字皮带扣严格参考角色资产图二；traincar 的车厢结构、色调、笔触与光感严格参考场景资产图一。

只提取资产图中的视觉设计。严禁生成角色三视图、灰色或白色摄影棚背景、DETAILS 细节格、色卡条、RAGHU VARMA 字样、VILLAIN LEGEND ICON 字样、HAIRSTYLE / MUSTACHE / SUNGLASSES 等标签文字、FRONT VIEW / SIDE VIEW / BACK VIEW / TOP VIEW 字样与水印。

【全局画风】

顶级院线级 2D 风格化动画电影。这不是真人电影，也不是写实 3D。

角色渲染：粗犷有力的手绘线稿，人物比例明显拉长与夸张——极长的四肢、极窄的腰、宽大的肩线、修长的脖颈。硬边分层阴影，高对比的色块，线条带有手绘的力度变化。

环境渲染：严格参考场景资产图一的厚涂手绘质感——可见的笔触、暖褐与青绿的色调、阳光透过车窗形成的强烈明暗对比、空气中漂浮的尘埃颗粒。车厢的木质座椅、铁质栏杆、行李架、吊环、风扇全部为手绘质感。

两者必须统一在同一部动画电影的视觉体系里。24fps 动画帧感，2.39:1 宽银幕，35mm 胶片颗粒 30%。

【角色 A：basha】

严格参考角色资产图三。南印度成年男性，极度修长夸张的体型，四肢细长，身形挺拔。浓密蓬乱的黑色中长发，向后与两侧炸开；浓密的黑色八字胡；戴一副黑色方形墨镜，全程不摘下。

服装：敞开领口的黑色衬衫，袖口卷至小臂，肩部与侧缝有暗红色描边；颈挂一条金链；深色长裤配棕色皮带与金属扣；腰间系一条深红色的长腰布，末端撕裂成不规则的布条，垂在身体右侧，随动作剧烈甩动；左腕戴一只金色手表；脚穿黑色尖头皮鞋。

他是这场戏的英雄。气场极其沉稳，动作经济、精准、致命。他几乎不做多余动作，但每一次出手都彻底解决问题。他从不慌张，从不喊叫，即使在最激烈的时刻也保持着一种近乎轻蔑的从容。

【角色 B：raghu】

严格参考角色资产图二。南印度成年男性，同样极度修长夸张的体型。浓密蓬乱的黑色中长发；浓密的黑色八字胡；戴一副金框飞行员墨镜，全程不摘下；嘴里始终叼着一支点燃的香烟，烟雾缭绕。

服装：紫红色的花纹衬衫，布满金色菱形暗纹，领口极大且尖锐，敞开着；颈挂一条粗金链与圆形吊坠；黑色长裤配一条宽皮带，皮带扣是一个巨大的金色圆形 R 字；脚穿黑色尖头皮鞋。

他是反派。动作张扬、夸张、带着表演性。他喜欢说话，喜欢炫耀，出手时带着挥霍的力道。他的自信在遭遇 basha 的第一次反击后开始出现裂缝。

【场景：traincar·行驶中的火车车厢】

严格参考场景资产图一。一节老旧的南印度长途列车车厢内部，正在高速行驶中。

【结构】车厢中央是一条狭长的过道，两侧是成排的木质长椅座位与铁质栏杆隔断。头顶沿过道两侧垂下密集的金属吊环；天花板上装着数台老式的金属吊扇，正在转动；两侧上方是堆满行李的金属行李架——藤箱、铁皮箱、布包、铺盖卷。

两侧是成排的车窗，部分开着，窗外的田野风景以极高的速度向后流动。车厢一端是敞开的车门，门外是飞驰而过的铁轨与旷野。车厢壁上贴着褪色的旧海报与手写涂鸦。

【光】强烈的午后阳光从一侧车窗斜射进来，在过道地面与座椅上投下一道道快速移动的明暗条纹——列车行进时，光条不断地扫过人物的身体与面部。空气中漂浮着被光照亮的尘埃。

【运动】整节车厢始终在晃动：地面有持续的纵向震颤，吊环随车身摆动，吊扇转动，行李架上的箱子轻微跳动。窗外的景物始终高速后移。列车绝不得停下。

【可破坏结构】吊环、吊扇、行李架与上面的行李、木质座椅靠背、铁质栏杆、车窗玻璃、车壁海报、地上的铝制茶壶与茶杯托盘——全部可以被撞碎、扯断、踩踏、砸飞。已经损坏的物体永久保持损坏。

【刚性空间锚点】过道的走向、两侧座椅的排列、头顶吊扇的位置与数量、车厢尽头敞开的车门，全片绝对不得漂移、消失或改变数量。

【乘客设定】第 0 秒时车厢里坐满了乘客——穿衬衫围腰布的男人、穿纱丽的女人、老人、小孩、卖茶的小贩。他们只是环境资产：在 0—6 秒之间惊慌地退向车厢两端，此后一直挤在远处的两头围观，绝不加入战斗、绝不靠近过道中央。他们的作用是提供尺度参照与反应。

【对白规则】

本片共有四句台词，全部为英文，在下方时间码中以引号标出。只有引号内的文字是被说出来的。其余所有文字——包括动作描述、表情描述、运镜说明与语气说明——全部是画面说明，绝对不得念出、不得配音、不得作为旁白。

全片台词不得超过四句，不得出现旁白与内心独白。乘客全程不说话。

【运镜规格总纲·南印度商业动作片语法】

全程一镜到底，绝对禁止硬切、剪辑、黑屏转场与定格。

24mm 超广角为主，配合极低机位仰拍。这是南印度商业电影的动作语法：

英雄镜头必须从极低的角度仰拍 basha，让他在画面中显得高大、压迫、不可撼动；他走动时，镜头贴着地面向后退，让他的身影逐渐充满画面。

每一句台词的瞬间，镜头必须稳定下来、停止晃动，给足画面的重量，说完立刻恢复运动。

速度必须有节奏变化：正常速度的连续打击 → 关键命中的瞬间明显减速（速度坡道，不是慢动作定格）→ 立刻恢复甚至加速。减速只允许出现在真正的重击命中与转身瞬间。

大量使用：贴地仰拍、沿过道的高速轨道推拉、Whip Pan、绕人物半圈的环绕、撞击时的弹性后震。

镜头只能穿过真实存在的空隙，不穿过人物、座椅、车壁或地面。

【密度要求】

6—26 秒之间，每秒必须呈现 3—5 次清晰的攻防状态变化。绝不允许一招一停、互相等待、轮流表演。速度快，但不是快进，不用模糊残影掩盖动作——每一拳每一脚都必须有支撑脚、腰胯旋转、重心交换、惯性与回收轨迹。车厢的狭窄必须被利用：所有动作都在一条窄过道里完成，双方不断利用座椅、栏杆、吊环、行李架借力与卸力。

【第一幕：0—6 秒·车厢清场】

0.0—2.5 秒
车厢在午后阳光中高速行驶，光条扫过满车的乘客。过道尽头，raghu 缓步走来，嘴角叼着烟，金框墨镜反着光，身后跟着一路被他推开的乘客。他抬手弹了弹烟灰。

过道的另一端，basha 坐在靠窗的位置上，一条腿翘着，手臂搭在椅背上，墨镜后看不出表情。阳光的光条一道道扫过他的脸。

运镜：从 raghu 的背后沿过道低机位向前推进，越过他的肩膀，一直推到远处坐着的 basha，两人被同一条过道连在一起。

2.5—6.0 秒
raghu 停在过道中央，一脚踩上旁边的座椅扶手，居高临下地指着 basha，用夸张的语气开口。

raghu: "This train ends at my station."

乘客们在这一瞬间同时反应过来，惊慌地朝车厢两端涌去，推搡着、抱着行李、拉着孩子，几秒内过道就空了。铝制茶壶被打翻在地，茶水洒出来，托盘滚到一边。

basha 没有立刻起身。他缓缓放下翘着的腿，一只手撑着椅背站起来，另一只手把垂在腰间的红色腰布一甩，甩到身后。他站直了——极长的身形在狭窄的过道里显得格外高。

运镜：raghu 说话时镜头稳定不动；乘客涌动时快速后退拉开；basha 起身时切换到极低的贴地仰拍，随他站直而缓缓升高，让他的身影充满画面。

【第二幕：6—16 秒·开打】

6.0—9.0 秒
raghu 率先冲上来，一记大幅度的摆拳。basha 只把头偏开三寸，摆拳砸在他身后的车窗上，玻璃炸出蛛网裂纹。

basha 反手一记极短的直拳正中 raghu 的胸口——raghu 整个人被打得倒飞出去，撞翻两排座椅靠背，木板碎裂。

【速度坡道】这一记直拳命中的瞬间明显减速，拳头陷进胸口、身体开始后飞的那一帧被拉长，随后立刻恢复正常速度。

raghu 从碎木中翻身起来，第一次收起了笑容。

运镜：贴地仰拍 basha 的出拳，命中瞬间稳定锁定接触点，随后被冲击弹性后震，跟随 raghu 倒飞的轨迹。

9.0—12.0 秒
raghu 抓起地上的铝制茶壶砸向 basha；basha 侧身让过，茶壶砸在车壁上炸开。

两人在狭窄的过道里贴身缠斗：raghu 连续出拳、肘击、踢腿；basha 依次用前臂格挡、偏头、沉肘、抬膝，每一次防守幅度都极小。basha 反击三下，raghu 被逼得连连后退，撞上头顶垂下的吊环，吊环被扯断了两只，金属环叮当落地。

basha 抓住 raghu 的衣领，把他整个人抡向一侧的座椅，raghu 的背重重砸在木质椅背上，靠背整块断裂。

运镜：沿过道平行跟随两人的缠斗，Whip Pan 跟随抡出的轨迹。

12.0—16.0 秒
raghu 从断裂的座椅中窜起，双手抓住头顶的行李架借力荡起，双脚齐蹬 basha 的胸口。basha 双臂交叉硬接，被蹬得后滑两米，鞋底在过道地面上刮出两道痕。

行李架承受不住，一整段从车壁上撕裂脱落，藤箱、铁皮箱与铺盖卷哗啦啦砸落一地。

basha 从翻滚的行李中踏步而出，一脚踢开挡路的铁皮箱，直线逼向 raghu。raghu 连续出拳想拦住他，basha 全部用小幅度的格挡卸开，一步都没有停，径直走到他面前。

运镜：镜头在 basha 逼近时沿过道向后退行，保持他正面充满画面，脚下不断有行李被踢开。

【第三幕：16—22 秒·英雄时刻】

16.0—18.5 秒
basha 一把抓住 raghu 的衣领，把他按在车厢壁上。raghu 双脚离地，烟从嘴里掉下来。

整个画面稳定下来。列车行进的光条一道一道扫过 basha 的墨镜与面孔。

basha 用极低沉、极平静的声音开口。

basha: "You booked the wrong ticket."

【速度坡道】说完这句话之后的半秒，画面保持稳定与安静，只有列车的节奏声与窗外掠过的风景。

运镜：极低机位仰拍 basha 的背影与被按住的 raghu，说话时镜头完全稳定、不晃动。

18.5—22.0 秒
basha 松手，raghu 落地的瞬间发狂般反扑——一记重拳砸中 basha 的下颌，basha 的头偏了过去，墨镜被打得歪斜。

车厢里安静了半秒。

basha 缓缓把头转回来，抬手用一根手指把墨镜推正。他笑了一下。

然后他动了：连续五记短促而沉重的打击，每一记都精准命中，raghu 被打得连连后退，撞碎栏杆、撞翻座椅、撞落一台吊扇——吊扇从天花板上扯落，扇叶砸在地上仍在转动。

【速度坡道】第五记打击命中的瞬间明显减速，随后立刻恢复。

运镜：basha 推正墨镜时镜头稳定特写；开打后沿过道高速后退跟随连续打击，每一记命中都有轻微的弹性后震。

【第四幕：22—30 秒·车门】

22.0—25.0 秒
raghu 被打退到车厢尽头那扇敞开的车门旁。窗外的旷野与铁轨以极高的速度向后流动，狂风从门口灌进来，把两人的头发与 basha 的红色腰布吹得剧烈翻飞。

raghu 抓住门框稳住身体，抹了一把嘴角，第一次露出真正的狼狈。他用尽最后的力气大喊。

raghu: "You think this ends here?"

运镜：低机位从 basha 身后越过肩膀拍向门口的 raghu，狂风与飞驰的背景同时入画。

25.0—28.0 秒
basha 一步一步朝他走过去，脚步不快，但每一步都很沉。狂风把他的黑衬衫与红腰布向后吹成一条直线。阳光的光条一道道扫过他。

他在 raghu 面前站定。

basha: "It ends where I say."

【速度坡道】说完这句话的瞬间，画面完全稳定。

运镜：镜头沿过道在他前方持续后退，极低机位仰拍，他的身影在狂风中逐渐充满整个画面，说话时镜头完全静止。

28.0—30.0 秒
basha 抬起一只脚，一记干净利落的侧踢正中 raghu 的胸口。

一名 6 英尺高的南印度成年男性，温暖的深肤色。浓密蓬松、带波浪的黑色头发，发间夹杂明显的灰白发丝。浓密修剪整齐的全脸胡须与八字胡，同样带灰白。

title: 水晶重构都市中的魔法少女
title_en: Magical Girl in a Crystalline Reconstructing City
path: prompts/其他/广告带货/goodcase-seedance-global-30-second-commercial-eedfe46e25bf--水晶重构都市中的魔法少女.md
prompt:
[GLOBAL] 30-second commercial. Photoreal live-action cinema texture, digital cinema camera, 35mm and 24mm lenses, shallow depth of field, real overcast rain-light, low-contrast cool grade, light film grain. 16:9. The spine of the film is one continuous over-the-shoulder tracking shot; all transitions are hidden inside motion blur and the crystallization effect.

[CHARACTER ANCHOR] @[image1] = the protagonist, a Japanese woman in her early twenties with a Tokyo street-fashion look: bleached pale-blonde wolf-cut shag with dark roots and a single mint-green streak in the under-layer; clean Japanese makeup — thin brows, pearlescent eyeshadow, nude lip; an oversized charcoal coach jacket with an original graphic print on the back, a long white tee underneath, baggy black cargo pants, chunky platform sneakers, layered silver jewelry, wired over-ear headphones around her neck, a small crossbody bag. Her face, hair and wardrobe stay 100% identical from 0s to 28s — never altered, never touched by any "generation" effect. She is the only constant in the film until the final beat. Emotional arc: oblivious → noticing → confused → stunned → awestruck → transformed.

[ARTWORK REFERENCE] @[image2] = the billboard artwork reference. Used ONLY for the flat graphic displayed on the bus-shelter digital billboard at 11–15s — including its complete typographic lockup ("Higgsfield × OpenAI" in small caps, "GPT IMAGE" in heavy white, the lime-green gradient "2.5", and the wide-tracked "SUNBURST" beneath), along with its layout, palette and composition. @[image2] must appear as a complete flat advertising image inside the billboard screen, carrying correct perspective, screen reflection and rain refraction across the glass surface. The woman pictured in @[image2] must NEVER be used for the protagonist's design, must NEVER leave the billboard screen, and must NEVER appear in the physical space of the scene. @[image1] and the woman in @[image2] are two entirely different people — never conflate them, never let one influence the other.

[CORE VISUAL MOTIF — THE ONLY TRANSFORMATION LANGUAGE IN THE FILM] Anything being "regenerated" must follow the exact same three-stage process: ① the original object disintegrates from its edges into a cloud of tens of thousands of small translucent white crystalline beads — like bubble-film or shattered glass pearls, with real volume, specular highlights and real weight; ② the bead cloud hangs briefly and rapidly rearranges; ③ the new form grows outward from inside the cloud, the final layer of beads absorbing into its surface and vanishing. Do NOT use flash cuts, dissolves, particle-dispersal effects, or digital-glitch styling for any transformation.

[SETTING] A Midtown Manhattan intersection after rain. Wet asphalt reflections, crosswalk stripes, yellow cabs, dense glass curtain walls and older stone buildings, neon and storefront signage, a fire hydrant, a newsstand, a bus-shelter digital billboard. Overcast diffused light throughout, no direct sun.

0–3s: Over-the-shoulder medium shot, following behind @[image1]. Her back is to camera as she stands on the crosswalk. To frame right, a 1970s green sedan in motion crystallizes entirely and reassembles as a black muscle car; a few frames later it crystallizes again and reassembles as a white wheel-less hover car. She hasn't registered it yet.

3–7s: The camera arcs around to her side. She starts looking around, the ends of her wolf cut swinging with the head turn. A businessman with a briefcase crystallizes mid-stride — the human-shaped bead cloud holds the walking pose for two full steps — and reassembles as a bare-chested barbarian warrior with feathered ornaments, continuing the same stride. Two or three more pedestrians crystallize in the background simultaneously, without pulling focus from her.

7–11s: Handheld tracking accelerates. More and more people on the street are replaced: a purple-skinned alien warrior woman, white-armored robot troopers, an original gold-suited superhero character (all original designs — no real-world recognizable characters, logos or trademarks). She walks faster, keeps turning to look back, her breathing quickening, one hand instinctively gripping her crossbody strap. The replacement frequency keeps rising, but the street's spatial relationships, lighting and wet reflections remain continuous throughout — no jump cuts.

11–15s: She stops in front of the bus shelter. The digital billboard inside cycles rapidly: a photoreal movie poster → a hand-painted concept illustration → a fashion editorial — each refresh executed with the same crystalline bead reassembly. It finally settles on the complete @[image2] artwork filling the entire screen, its typography and palette exactly as in @[image2]. She raises a hand and points at the screen, mouth open, unable to speak.

15–18s: The camera tilts down to her feet. The sidewalk paving crystallizes outward from where she stands in a perfect circle, white beads spreading three meters along the joints between slabs, the manhole cover and the standing water turning crystalline with it. She looks down. The ground gives out beneath her platform sneakers.

18–21s: Wide 24mm. The ground collapses and she falls straight down. The camera falls with her looking up — the entire city contracts above her into a shrinking square opening, the buildings on either side peeling away, tumbling and receding upward like building blocks, the sky turning to deep blue-black void. She throws her arms out, her hair, jacket hem and bag strap lifted by the updraft.

21–24s: During the fall the visual style jumps repeatedly, each jump bridged by one full-frame sweep of crystalline beads. In order: ① rich 1980s film stock — high saturation, heavy halation, heavy grain; ② black-and-white halftone manga panel — the character rendered in ink linework and dot screens against dense radial speed lines; ③ a neon purple-blue digital vortex with long light streaks stretching backward at speed; ④ near-total darkness with extreme motion blur. Her facial structure, hair and wardrobe must remain recognizably the same person in every one of these styles.

24–27s: She lands flat on her back on a smooth white floor. A wide lens pushes in slowly and tilts up to reveal the environment: an infinitely extending pure-white showroom/hangar with a gridded softbox ceiling. Hundreds of black circular pedestals cover the floor, each holding a character statue or a parked vehicle — original-design warriors, mechs, robots, sci-fi troopers, plus large military aircraft and helicopters. A small line of floating white label text sits in front of each pedestal: "FANTASY CHARACTER", "VEHICLE", "MECH" — set at a small point size, present purely as environmental information.

27–28s: She sits up and pushes herself to her feet, turning slowly to take in the hall, eyes widening in awe. The camera settles into a full-body medium-wide, centered, the statue array receding out of focus behind her.

28–30s [THE FINAL TRANSFORMATION]: The instant she stands fully upright, the crystalline beads rise from the floor around her feet and sweep up her body in one continuous wave — and for the first time in the film, SHE is the thing being regenerated. Her streetwear disintegrates into the bead cloud and a magical-girl battle uniform grows outward in its place, following the exact same three-stage motif, generating in a readable order from the torso outward: a white high-collar fitted bodice → a mint-green sailor collar with three silver stripes → a deep mint pleated skirt with silver trim, its pleats opening one by one → long white gloves to the upper arm with mint piping → white knee-high boots with a mid heel and mint cuffs → layered silver jewelry reforming as a silver star brooch at her chest → a large mint-green bow at her back with long ribbons falling to the backs of her knees → a fine silver tiara condensing across her forehead. Her face, hairstyle, hair color, the mint streak and the headphones around her neck remain completely unchanged — only the clothing is regenerated. The last beads absorb into the fabric. She looks down at her own hands, then slowly raises her head, the ribbons still settling behind her, and looks straight past camera with a small, dawning smile. The film cuts on that frame. No end card, no title, no tagline, no subtitle of any kind.

[SOUND] Rain and wet-road traffic, urban ambient bed; high-frequency glass/ice shatter-and-rearrange sounds on every crystallization; a short bright locking tone as each reassembly completes; electronic refresh tones from the billboard; low-frequency collapse as the ground gives way; wind through the fall, with a distinct timbre shift for each of the four style jumps (film hiss / paper-and-ink texture / synth sweep / silence); one muffled impact on landing; near-total quiet inside the hall with only faint HVAC room tone; then, over the final transformation, an ascending shimmer of silk and crystal, each garment piece seating with a crisp click, the bow tying with a single sweep of ribbon, and one clear bell tone as the tiara locks in. One escalating electronic music bed ties it together, landing its final hit on her raised head.

[HARD RULES] @[image1]'s face, hairstyle, hair color and headphones are absolutely unchanged across all 30 seconds. Her wardrobe is unchanged from 0s to 28s and may be regenerated ONLY in the 28–30s final beat — the transformation affects clothing only and must never alter her face, hair or identity. All other replacements happen only to the people, vehicles, ground and environment around her. The film may use only the single "crystalline bead disintegration → rearrangement → growth" transformation language, including for the final costume change; no other transition effect may be mixed in. From 0–18s the film must hold the logic of one spatially continuous tracking shot — the street's architecture, lighting and wet reflections must never jump. Every character and vehicle in the hall must be an original design; no real-world recognizable characters, brand marks, trademarks or identifiable film properties may appear, and the final magical-girl uniform must be an original design, not any existing anime character's costume. The only brand copy permitted anywhere in the film is the @[image2] artwork on the billboard screen at 11–15s, existing solely as a flat image inside that screen and never repeated elsewhere. No end card, no title card, no subtitles, no watermark, no overlaid text anywhere in the film. Avoid: cartoon rendering, game-CG feel, plastic materials, full-frame bloom, digital-glitch transitions, weightless floating, incorrect finger structure, garbled text, revealing or suggestive posing or camera angles.

【16.0—21.0 秒｜连锁崩塌】

@redsamurai 沿着散落的书脊奔跑，跃上那只米黄色的粗陶笔筒的边缘。@bluesamurai 蹬着圆形木托追上去。

两人在笔筒的口沿上交手——极窄的圆形边缘上，刀影翻飞。@bluesamurai 一记扫击逼得 @redsamurai 后退，脚下打滑——他伸手抓住笔筒沿稳住身体，但整只笔筒被这股力量晃动起来。

笔筒摇了两下，倒了。

它从木托上滚落，撞上旁边装着毛笔的木筒，毛笔们哗啦一声全部倾倒散开，笔杆滚了满桌。其中一支毛笔滑下去，撞倒了那只皮质旧箱子的黄铜搭扣，箱盖弹开。

@bluesamurai 在倾倒的笔杆之间跳跃，@redsamurai 在滚动的笔筒上保持平衡，两人的刀始终没有停。

运镜：随两人跃上笔筒急速抬升，笔筒倾倒时镜头随之倾斜下坠，随后贴桌面跟随连锁倒塌的路径。

【21.0—24.5 秒｜最高密度】

密度提升到全片最高。

两人在一片狼藉中高速缠斗：滚动的笔杆、散开的书页、翻倒的笔筒、弹开的皮箱。每秒五到七次的攻防转换——刺、格、拨、斩、卸、踏、翻、靠。

@redsamurai 蹬着那尊金属武士雕像的底座弹起，雕像被震得歪向一侧；@bluesamurai 从空中劈下，刀锋擦过那幅"魂"字挂轴的画框——画框被撞得歪斜，从架子上滑下来靠在墙边。

桌面上的一只小物被踢飞出去，在桌沿弹了一下，掉进了黑暗里。

运镜：极小半径贴身环绕两人，刀刃接触点始终清晰，背景的混乱在浅景深中虚化成一片色块。

【24.5—26.5 秒｜门声】

远处传来一声木门被推开的吱呀声，接着是拖鞋踩在木地板上的脚步声，正在靠近。

两人在半空中同时僵住——刀尖相抵，两双线条构成的眼睛同时转向门的方向。

安静了半秒。

然后他们同时撒手，朝书本狂奔。

运镜：在门声响起的瞬间镜头完全停住，稳定锁定僵在半空的两人，随后急速跟随他们冲向书本的路线。

【26.5—28.5 秒｜归位】

两人跃回摊开的书页上。

@bluesamurai 冲回左页，@redsamurai 冲回右页，各自滑进纸面上那两块空白的位置里——他们的线条重新塌平、摊开、融回纸张的纤维中，恢复成原来那个弓步握刀的对峙姿势。

最后一根还在抖动的红色线条也静止了下来。

书页上只剩下两幅画。只是那道被刀划开的口子还在，纸边还翻卷着。

运镜：从他们奔跑的高度急速下降至贴纸面的角度，在他们塌回纸面的瞬间稳定锁定，随后缓缓上升。

【28.5—30.0 秒｜爷爷】

一个身影出现在画面的边缘——一位年迈的日本老人，穿着素色的和式居家服，花白的短发，脸上布满皱纹，手里还端着一只热气腾腾的茶杯。

他停在门口，抬起头。

镜头随他的视线扫过整个房间：翻倒的陶笔筒、滚了满桌的毛笔、散落的书本、歪斜的"魂"字挂轴、弹开的皮箱、翻了面的眼镜、满地的狼藉。

老人的眼睛慢慢睁大了。他的嘴微微张开。茶杯在他手里停住，热气继续向上飘。

他看向桌上摊开的那本速写本——上面只有两幅安安静静的彩铅素描。

最后一帧：老人站在门口，端着茶杯，目瞪口呆地看着一屋子的狼藉；桌上那本速写本静静地摊着，左页是蓝色的武士，右页是红色的武士，两把刀的刀尖在中缝处相抵，一动不动。画面自然收束。

运镜：从桌面缓缓摇向门口的老人，随他的视线扫过狼藉的房间，最后回到那本安静的速写本上，缓慢后拉至广角。不定格，不摆造型——茶杯的热气还在飘，被割破的纸边还在轻轻颤动。

【全局约束与防崩条件】

masterpiece, highest quality。混合渲染：纯彩铅线条的角色 + 照片级真实的房间。

@bluesamurai 全程是蓝色彩铅线条，@redsamurai 全程是红色彩铅线条。两者的颜色绝不互换、绝不混色、绝不变成实体人物、绝不长出皮肤或布料质感。

两人的体型全程保持在速写本上画着的那么小，绝不放大、绝不变成真人尺寸。

全场只允许存在两把刀，都是线条构成的。严禁武器复制或尺寸漂移。

破坏只能单向累积：倒下的笔筒、散落的毛笔、翻倒的书本、歪斜的挂轴、弹开的皮箱、被割破的纸页，全部永久保持损坏状态，绝不复原。

破坏必须由实际接触触发。禁止物件无缘无故倒下，禁止破坏早于接触。

房间的光照方向全程一致，绝不改变。

老人只在 28.5 秒之后出现，此前绝对不得入画。他全程不说话、不进入房间、不触碰任何东西，只是站在门口看着。

【负面提示词】

角色变成实体人物，角色长出皮肤，角色长出布料质感，角色变成 3D 模型，角色变成真人，角色失去线条质感，线条变成实心色块，蓝色武士变红，红色武士变蓝，两人颜色混淆，颜色互换；

角色变大，角色变成真人尺寸，角色比笔筒高，角色比书本大，体型漂移，角色站在地板上，角色离开桌面；

角色用蛮力砸碎家具，角色徒手掀翻书桌，角色击碎墙壁，破坏不符合体型，物件凭空爆炸，物件无缘无故倒下，破坏早于接触；

老人提前出现，老人在 28.5 秒之前入画，老人走进房间，老人说话，老人拿起速写本，老人碰倒东西，出现第二个人，出现其他角色，出现宠物；

角色在老人出现时还在动，角色没有归位，角色归位姿势错误，角色归位到错误的页面，纸上的画消失，纸上出现第三幅画；

出现台词，出现对白，旁白，内心独白，念出动作描述文字，念出运镜说明，字幕，Logo，UI，水印；

一招一停，互相等待，轮流表演，摆 pose，长时间蓄力，全片慢动作，定格帧，快进感，跳帧加速，重复招式，原地乱挥，动作没有重量；

彩色能量，发光特效，气功，火焰，雷电，激光，魔法光效，粒子特效，漫画速度线；

房间恢复整洁，倒下的笔筒复位，毛笔回到笔筒，书本自动叠好，挂轴自动扶正，被割破的纸自动愈合；

明亮的房间，白天，阳光直射，日光灯，现代办公室，空荡的桌面，室外场景，光照方向改变；

硬切，多机位剪辑，黑屏转场，镜头瞬移，持续晃动，过量滚转，镜头穿过物件或桌面，低清晰度，卡顿，卡通渲染，电子游戏过场感，过曝，过度锐化。

Ahead: a red semi truck with a long flatbed trailer carrying massive steel coils. Core subject is the same overweight elderly woman in a pale pink floral bathrobe, with tight silver-gray permed curls, walking on the roadside — who, when a giant steel coil breaks loose and rolls off the trailer, calmly stops it with her hands, picks it up, and heaves it back onto the flatbed like it weighs nothing. Tone: absurd but played completely straight, like real footage of something impossible — no reactions from her, pure viral-video energy. Style: raw dashcam realism only — no cinematic grading, no camera movement beyond the car's own driving, no slow motion, zero cuts. Grounded physics on EVERYTHING except her strength: the coil has true massive weight in how it falls, rolls, and lands. The road ahead is otherwise empty of pedestrians; the filming car and the truck both slow safely; nobody is ever in the coil's path; nobody is injured on screen.

阶段一 (0–7s, the drop): Fixed dashcam view following the red flatbed truck at normal traffic distance. A strap visibly snaps on the trailer — one enormous steel coil (taller than a person) tips, slides off the flatbed's edge, and CRASHES onto the asphalt with real catastrophic mass: the road surface cracking under the impact, a bounce of only centimeters despite the drop, dust and grit jumping in a ring, the trailer visibly rocking upward from the released weight. The coil begins rolling toward the roadside on its own momentum, slow and unstoppable, wobbling slightly on its axis. The truck's brake lights flare; it pulls over ahead. The filming car brakes gently, keeping distance, the dashcam view dipping slightly with the deceleration.

阶段二 (7–14s, the stop): Same fixed dashcam view. From the tree-lined sidewalk, the grandma in the floral bathrobe walks into frame at a completely normal unhurried pace, angling to meet the rolling coil — and simply puts both palms flat against its face. The coil stops dead against her hands: her slippers slide backward a few centimeters on the grit as she absorbs its rolling momentum, her body leaning into it at a realistic bracing angle, bathrobe swaying forward from the deceleration — then stillness. She straightens up and looks at the coil the way someone looks at a fallen bag of rice. The truck driver climbs down from the cab far ahead, jogging back, then slowing to a stunned stop mid-road.

阶段三 (14–22s, the lift): Continuous dashcam view. She squats beside the coil with an ordinary, practical motion — hands finding the coil's inner bore and bottom edge — and stands up WITH IT: the coil rising off the ground in her arms, its colossal mass now readable only in the physics around her — her slippers pressing visible marks into the softened asphalt, small stones cracking under her feet, her steps short and flat-footed under the load, the coil's wrapped steel bands creaking. She carries it toward the pulled-over trailer at a normal walking pace, body tilted back to counterbalance, the truck driver backing away with both hands on his head. The dashcam car rolls slowly closer, the view growing, heat shimmer off the road.

阶段四 (22–30s, the throw + walk-off): Same continuous view. At the trailer's side she rocks the coil back once — a real preparatory counter-swing — and HEAVES it up onto the flatbed: the coil arcs a short, heavy, believable trajectory, lands on the trailer bed with a colossal BANG, the entire trailer slamming down on its suspension, tires bulging, the tractor unit bouncing, dust jumping off every surface, and the coil settling into place with one slow half-rotation before going still. The trailer rocks twice more on its springs, settling. She wipes her palms against each other twice — the universal "done" gesture — turns, and walks back toward the sidewalk at the same unhurried pace, exiting frame as the truck driver stands frozen beside his trailer. Ends with the dashcam car slowly driving past the scene: the trailer still faintly swaying, the driver staring, the cracked dent in the asphalt where the coil landed sliding past the bottom of frame.

保持一致: Same elderly woman, same pale pink floral bathrobe, same tight silver-gray permed curls (never bald), slippers throughout; the red semi with flatbed trailer and giant steel coils; ONE continuous fixed dashcam shot from the following car — hood and wiper edge at bottom of frame, wide-angle distortion, washed dashcam colors, road vibration, compression-artifact texture, the view moving only with the car's own braking and slow rolling; daylight, tree-lined road; zero cuts. Her demeanor is completely ordinary and unhurried — normal walking pace, practical squat-and-lift, the palm-wipe — played dead straight, no showing off; the comedy IS the contrast between the impossible feat and her total nonchalance. All physics real EXCEPT her strength: the coil falls with catastrophic mass (cracked asphalt, centimeter bounce, trailer rocking upward on release), rolls with slow unstoppable momentum, stops against her hands with her slippers sliding and body bracing, presses her footprints into asphalt during the carry, and lands back on the trailer with full suspension slam, tire bulge, double rebound and a settling half-rotation; secondary motion on dust, grit, bathrobe and the trailer's springs throughout. Road otherwise empty of pedestrians; the driver and filming car always at a safe distance; nobody in the coil's path; nobody injured. No on-screen text, no subtitles, no slow motion, no cuts.

Audio: cabin interior of the filming car — engine idle, faint radio murmur, a soft "ồ" from the unseen driver — under the outside sounds carried muffled through the windshield: the strap snapping, the coil's earth-shaking impact and cracking asphalt, its heavy grinding roll, the scrape of her slippers as she stops it, steel bands creaking during the carry, her flat footsteps, the trailer's colossal BANG and suspension slam with double rebound, dust settling, the truck driver's distant exclamation, traffic idling, the filming car slowly accelerating past. path: prompts/真人/特效向/动作大片/goodcase-seedance-historical-dramatization-an-original-cinem--冲绳战场军医冒火救援伤兵.md
prompt:
30 seconds | 16:9 | hyper-realistic historical war-film recreation | documentary realism | MULTISHOT

HISTORICAL DRAMATIZATION — An original cinematic reconstruction inspired by the Battle of Okinawa in 1945. The story follows a fictional U.S. Army combat medic attempting to evacuate wounded soldiers from an exposed battlefield. Do not recreate any specific scene, character, dialogue, costume design, camera composition, or sequence from any existing film.

CORE CONCEPT
A young combat medic remains behind after his unit moves forward. Instead of becoming part of the fighting, he moves through smoke, mud and artillery fire searching for wounded soldiers and bringing them toward safety. The sequence emphasizes courage, exhaustion, confusion and the physical reality of a battlefield rather than glorifying combat.

SETTING
Okinawa, Japan — spring 1945. Rugged limestone escarpment, muddy defensive positions, damaged vegetation, smoke-filled battlefield, earthworks, abandoned equipment, scattered ammunition crates, military stretchers and distant artillery. Overcast tropical sky gradually brightening toward morning.

CHARACTERS
MAIN MEDIC — Fictional American Army combat medic, mid-20s, exhausted face, short regulation haircut, olive-drab 1940s combat uniform, steel helmet, canvas medical bag, field dressings and worn boots.

WOUNDED SOLDIER 1 — Young American infantryman, exhausted and injured, period-correct uniform and equipment.

WOUNDED SOLDIER 2 — Another fictional infantryman trapped farther across the exposed ground.

BACKGROUND SOLDIERS — Period-accurate American and Japanese forces visible only as distant silhouettes through smoke. No identifiable real individuals.

STORY — MULTISHOT VISUALS

00:00–02.5 — DAWN
24mm wide establishing shot of an Okinawa battlefield covered in smoke and mist. Exhausted American soldiers move between muddy defensive positions while distant artillery flashes across the horizon. MAIN MEDIC stands alone near a damaged defensive position, scanning the battlefield.

02.5–05 — DISCOVERY
50mm handheld tracking shot as the medic hears a faint voice. He moves through smoke and discovers WOUNDED SOLDIER 1 lying behind a collapsed section of earthwork. The medic immediately kneels and checks him.

05–07.5 — FIRST AID
85mm intimate close-up of the medic applying a field dressing. His hands shake slightly from exhaustion. Mud and sweat cover his face. Distant artillery causes the ground to tremble.

07.5–10 — CARRY
35mm handheld shot. The medic pulls the wounded soldier onto his shoulders and begins moving through the mud. His boots sink into the wet ground. He struggles under the weight but continues.

10–12.5 — INCOMING FIRE
A distant artillery impact throws dirt into the air nearby. The medic instinctively drops low, shielding the wounded soldier with his body. Smoke rolls across the frame.

12.5–15 — HEAR ANOTHER VOICE
The medic looks toward a distant voice coming through the smoke. He realizes another wounded soldier is still behind him. After a brief moment of hesitation, he turns around and moves back.

15–17.5 — SECOND CASUALTY
50mm handheld movement through dense smoke. The medic reaches WOUNDED SOLDIER 2, who is trapped beside damaged equipment. The medic pulls debris away and checks his condition.

17.5–20 — IMPROVISED STRETCHER
35mm close tracking shot. The medic uses a canvas sheet and available wooden poles to construct a crude field stretcher. His movements are rushed but practical and believable.

20–22.5 — EXTRACTION
Wide 24mm shot. The medic drags the improvised stretcher across exposed muddy ground. Smoke obscures the battlefield behind him while artillery flashes intermittently in the distance.

22.5–25 — THE ESCARPMENT
The medic reaches the edge of the rocky escarpment. He lowers himself carefully and begins moving the wounded soldier toward a safer lower position.

25–27.5 — HUMAN MOMENT
85mm close-up. The wounded soldier looks up at the medic. The medic briefly reassures him with a calm expression before continuing. No heroic speech, no exaggerated emotion.

27.5–30 — FINAL REVEAL
24mm wide shot from behind the medic. He helps both wounded soldiers toward a sheltered position while the enormous Okinawa battlefield stretches behind them through smoke and morning light. The camera holds on the scale of the battlefield as the three figures become small against the landscape.

CAMERA
Large-format historical cinema camera language combined with embedded war-correspondent realism. 24mm for battlefield scale, 35mm for movement and action, 50mm for human interaction, 85mm for intimate details. Handheld shoulder-mounted movement, natural camera shake, imperfect framing, realistic focus changes, atmospheric obstruction from smoke and dust. No modern drone aesthetic, no impossible camera movement.

LIGHTING
Soft overcast Okinawa morning light, cold gray atmosphere, muted sunlight through smoke, warm distant artillery flashes, natural skin highlights and subtle atmospheric haze. No theatrical spotlighting.

PHYSICS
Realistic body weight, fatigue, mud resistance, stretcher weight, smoke movement, artillery shockwaves, falling debris, clothing movement and ground interaction. The medic struggles physically under the wounded soldier’s weight. No superhuman strength or impossible movement.

HUMAN PERFORMANCE
Exhaustion is visible in posture, breathing and movement. The medic behaves professionally but is visibly frightened and tired. Wounded soldiers respond naturally to pain and shock. Background soldiers move independently and react to distant impacts without synchronized choreography.

AUDIO
Authentic battlefield soundscape: distant artillery, rifle fire far across the battlefield, shouting, heavy breathing, boots in mud, equipment rattling, stretcher fabric stretching, wind through vegetation and debris impacts. Music is extremely restrained and secondary to environmental sound.

VISUAL CHARACTER
Photorealistic live-action historical war cinematography. Natural skin texture, authentic 1945 uniforms, weathered equipment, mud, sweat, smoke, atmospheric depth, realistic film grain and subtle highlight halation. No plastic skin, no videogame appearance, no exaggerated color grading.

COLOR GRADE
Muted olive greens, dirty browns, gray-blue atmospheric shadows, warm skin tones and restrained highlights. Slightly desaturated period-war-film palette while maintaining natural colors.

HISTORICAL REALISM
Period-correct American military equipment, clothing, medical supplies, terrain and battlefield environment. No modern weapons, vehicles, helmets, medical equipment, tactical gear or technology.

CONTINUITY
MAIN MEDIC, both wounded soldiers, uniforms, equipment, medical bag, weather and battlefield geography remain consistent across all shots. Wounds remain visually consistent without graphic gore. The sequence progresses logically from discovery → treatment → evacuation → second rescue → extraction.

manik 的外貌、发型、八字胡、金框飞行员墨镜、黑色 786 球衣、红色腕带与红黑高帮球鞋严格参考角色资产图一；antony 的外貌、发型、无胡须的脸、黑框墨镜、黑色 ANTONY 1 号球衣、黑色腕带与红黑高帮球鞋严格参考角色资产图二；court 的球场结构、铁丝网、涂鸦墙、篮架、树影、远处城市天际线与光感严格参考场景资产图三。

只提取资产图中的视觉设计。严禁生成角色三视图、灰色或白色摄影棚背景、DETAILS & SWATCHES 细节格、色卡条、尺寸标注线、6ft 183cm 字样、7FT 213CM 字样、BAASHA 字样、HEIGHT / BUILD / STYLE / SPECIALTY 等表格文字、FRONT VIEW / SIDE VIEW / BACK VIEW / TOP-DOWN VIEW 字样与水印。

【全局画风】

顶级院线级 2D 风格化动画电影。这不是真人电影，也不是写实 3D。

角色渲染：清晰有力的手绘线稿，人物比例极度夸张拉长——细长的四肢、极窄的腰身、修长的脖颈、偏大的头部。硬边分层阴影，高饱和的黑、红、橙色块，线条带有手绘的力度变化。

24fps 动画帧感，2.39:1 宽银幕，明亮的午后阳光，35mm 胶片颗粒 25%。

【体型比例·必须严格遵守】

manik 身高 6 英尺（183cm），身形精瘦修长。
antony 身高 7 英尺（213cm），比 manik 高出整整一个头，四肢更长、更瘦削。

严格参考角色资产图一。南印度成年男性，6 英尺，精瘦修长。浓密蓬乱的黑色卷发向两侧与后方炸开；浓密的黑色八字胡；戴一副金框飞行员墨镜，全程不摘下。

他的一切都建立在"不着急"上。周围越乱，他越慢。

他享受表演，享受被注视。他的每一个炫技动作都是做给 manik 看的。当 manik 完全不给反应时，他的笑容会一点一点僵掉。

【场景：court·城市街头球场】

严格参考场景资产图三。明亮午后的城市户外水泥篮球场。

【结构】开裂的浅灰色水泥地面，白色的场地线已经磨损褪色。画面一侧立着一座旧篮架：磨白的透明篮板上布满涂鸦与贴纸，橙色篮圈挂着白色的网。场地四周围着高大的绿色铁丝网，网上挂着手绘的旧横幅与标语牌。铁丝网下方是布满彩色涂鸦的矮墙。

【环境】球场一侧有一棵枝叶茂盛的大树，阳光从树叶间穿过，在水泥地上投下大片斑驳晃动的树影。另一侧立着一根旧灯柱与一块告示牌。篮架柱子下靠着一台老式手提音响，旁边滚着一颗备用的篮球。

【远景】铁丝网之外是低矮的红砖楼房、水塔、更远处是蓝天下的城市天际线与高楼剪影。天空是明亮的钴蓝色，飘着蓬松的白云，有几道飞机拉出的白线。

【光】强烈的午后阳光从画面一侧斜射进来，在水泥地上拉出长长的影子。逆光处产生明显的光晕与镜头眩光。空气中漂浮着被阳光照亮的细小尘埃与飞扬的落叶。

【围观者】球场边缘散布着十几名围观的年轻人——靠在铁丝网上、坐在矮墙上、站在场边。他们只是环境资产与尺度参照：全程待在场地边缘，绝不进入球场中央、绝不加入冲突。他们的作用是提供反应：惊呼、起身、后退、张大嘴。

【刚性空间锚点】篮架的位置、大树的位置、铁丝网的走向、远处城市天际线，全片绝对不得漂移、消失或改变数量。

【风格融合规则·南印度商业动作片 + 武侠】

本片是两种电影语汇的融合，两者分工明确：

【运镜与节奏来自南印度商业动作片】极低机位仰拍英雄；台词瞬间镜头完全停止晃动；速度坡道只出现在关键命中的瞬间；英雄的每一次出场与转身都带着压迫性的画面重量。

【物理与动作来自武侠】篮球在空中的滞空时间明显超出现实；被接住的球在掌心瞬间彻底静止；冲刺时距离在一瞬间被跨越；每一次重击的落点都炸开一圈贴地的尘环；头发与衣物遵循夸张的惯性。

严禁彩色能量、发光特效、火焰、雷电或任何超自然光效。所有的夸张都必须表现为空气、尘土、气浪与惯性——纯物理。

【对白规则】

本片只有一句台词，为英文，在下方时间码中以引号标出。只有引号内的文字是被说出来的。其余所有文字——包括动作描述、表情描述、举止说明与运镜说明——全部是画面说明，绝对不得念出、不得配音、不得作为旁白。

全片台词不得超过一句。antony 全程不说话。围观者全程不说话。不得出现旁白与内心独白。

【运镜规格总纲】

全程一镜到底，绝对禁止硬切、剪辑、黑屏转场与定格。

24mm 超广角为主，配合极低机位仰拍。镜头在球场上流畅地绕行、推拉、横移，始终跟随动作。

拍 manik 时必须从极低的角度仰拍，让他在画面中显得高大、沉稳、不可撼动；拍 antony 的炫技时镜头贴着地面跟随球的运动。

速度坡道只允许出现在两个瞬间：7 秒接球的瞬间、14 秒出拳命中的瞬间。其余全部为正常速度。绝不允许全片慢动作、绝不允许定格。

镜头只能穿过真实存在的空隙，不穿过人物、篮架、铁丝网或地面。

【密度要求】

0—6 秒之间，antony 的运球必须每秒呈现 3—5 次清晰的动作变化——绝不允许单调重复地原地拍球。11.5—15 秒之间达到每秒 5—7 次的动作密度。速度快，但不是快进，不用模糊残影掩盖动作。

【0.0—3.0 秒·炫技】

明亮的午后阳光下，antony 在球场中央运球。他的动作又快又花：胯下运球、背后换手、转身拉球、高低交替的快速拍打。篮球砸在开裂的水泥地上，每一次都溅起一小蓬尘土，声音清脆响亮。他的长手长脚甩出夸张的弧线，蓬乱的头发跟着甩动。

他一边运球一边斜眼看向场边，下巴抬高，嘴角咧开一个不达眼底的笑，摊开一只手做了个夸张的、慢半拍的邀请手势。

场边的围观者跟着他的动作发出惊呼，有人拍手，有人站了起来。

运镜：贴地低机位跟随篮球的弹跳，随后升起环绕 antony 半圈，最后顺着他的视线方向摇向场边。

【3.0—5.0 秒·无动于衷】

镜头摇到球场边缘：manik 靠在铁丝网旁站着。

他的重心完全压在一条腿上，另一条腿随意前伸，一只手插在球裤口袋里。他一动不动。阳光透过树叶在他身上洒下晃动的斑驳光点，风把他蓬乱的黑色卷发轻轻吹起。金框墨镜后面看不出任何表情。

他抬起另一只手，用拇指和食指慢慢捻了一下八字胡的尾端。仅此而已。

场边的欢呼声与球场中央的炫技，他一点反应都没有。

运镜：从极低的角度仰拍 manik，镜头缓缓从他的球鞋升到面部，把他在树影与铁丝网前的身影完整纳入画面。

【5.0—6.5 秒·变脸】

antony 看见这个反应——或者说，看见了没有反应。他的笑容一点一点僵掉了。

他猛地发力，三次极快的胯下变向后直线突进，运球压低、步幅拉大，笔直杀向篮架。他高高跃起，长长的手臂举球过顶，做出上篮的姿势。

就在最高点，他的头转向了场边的 manik。墨镜后的脸上，那个假笑彻底消失。

运镜：沿他的突进路线快速倒飞，随他的起跳急速抬升，在最高点稳定锁定他转头的那一刻。

【6.5—7.5 秒·投掷与接球】

以下三步必须严格按先后顺序发生，绝对不得同时发生：

第一步：antony 在半空中改变动作——他没有把球投向篮筐，而是双手抡圆，用尽全力把篮球笔直砸向场边 manik 的面门。篮球以极高的速度撕开空气飞出，球后拖出一道被扰动的尘埃与热浪扭曲的轨迹。

第二步：manik 的双脚一步都没有移动，身体一寸都没有偏转。只有他的右手抬了起来，掌心朝前，迎向飞来的球。

第三步：篮球重重砸进他的掌心，在那一刻彻底静止——球完全停在他张开的手掌里，正好悬在他的脸前方，把他整张脸严严实实地挡住。他的手臂只被冲力压得向后退了不到一寸。他的脚下炸开一圈贴地的尘环，向四周扩散。

【速度坡道】篮球砸进掌心、彻底静止的那一瞬间明显减速，球面在掌心压出形变、尘环开始向外扩散的那一段被拉长，随后立刻恢复正常速度。

场边的围观者集体僵住，有人捂住了嘴。antony 落回地面，脸上第一次出现了不确定。

运镜：与篮球并排同速跟随其飞行轨迹，在球砸进掌心的瞬间稳定锁定接触点，随后被尘环推得轻微后退。

【7.5—10.5 秒·揭示与台词】

manik 的手臂缓缓落下，篮球随着手掌一起下移——他的脸从球后一点一点显露出来：先是蓬乱的头发，然后是金框墨镜，然后是八字胡。

他的嘴角先在一侧扬起，然后慢慢扩散成一个完整的笑。

整个画面稳定下来，只有风吹过铁丝网的声音与树叶的沙沙声。

manik: "This is how you want to play?"

【构图】说这句话时镜头完全稳定、不晃动，从极低的角度仰拍 manik，让他在蓝天与树影的背景前显得高大。

运镜：随球下移缓缓上摇至他的面部，台词期间镜头完全静止。

【10.5—12.5 秒·抛球】

manik 用手腕轻轻一弹，把篮球笔直地抛向天空。

球垂直上升，越升越高，在钴蓝色的天空与白云之间变成一个越来越小的橙色圆点。它的滞空时间明显超出现实——它就那样一直在升。

manik 仰头看着它。antony 也仰头看着它。两个人同时仰着头，整个球场安静了下来，只有球在空气中翻滚的细微声音。

运镜：随球垂直上摇，一路升到天空中的球与白云，短暂停留，随后急速下摇回到两人身上。

【12.5—15.0 秒·出拳】

manik 的头猛地从天空转回来，正对 antony。

他动了。

他站过的地方只留下一圈炸开的尘土——他已经跨过了整个球场的距离。他压低身体直线冲刺，树影一道道从他身上刷过，球鞋在水泥地上蹬出连续的尘痕，蓬乱的头发被气流整个向后压平。

antony 还仰着头看天。等他把头低下来时，manik 已经到了他面前。

manik 的右拳从下方轰出，正中 antony 的下颌。

【速度坡道】拳头命中面部的那一瞬间明显减速：antony 的头被打得整个向后甩去，黑色方框墨镜从他脸上飞脱出去，在空中翻转，口水与汗珠被震成一片飞沫，他的双脚离开地面。落点处炸开一圈贴地的尘环。随后立刻恢复正常速度。

场边的围观者集体跳了起来。

最后一帧：manik 的拳头仍抵在 antony 的脸上，antony 双脚离地、身体向后飞起、墨镜在空中翻转；而在他们两人的正上方，那颗橙色的篮球仍然停在高高的蓝天上。画面自然收束。

运镜：沿 manik 的冲刺路线贴地倒飞，在出拳命中的瞬间稳定锁定接触点，随后被冲击弹性后退并轻微抬升，把两人与天空中那颗小小的篮球同时纳入画面。不定格，不摆造型。

【全局约束与防崩条件】

masterpiece, highest quality, 顶级院线级 2D 风格化动画电影。

manik 与 antony 的面孔、发型、墨镜、球衣配色与配件全程一致：manik 始终有浓密的八字胡、金框飞行员墨镜、786 号球衣；antony 始终没有胡子、戴黑色方框墨镜、ANTONY 1 号球衣。两人换位后继续按标签区分身份，不得依赖左右位置。

manik 的墨镜全程不摘下、不脱落、不碎裂。antony 的墨镜只在 14 秒被打飞这一次。

7 英尺对 6 英尺的身高差全程严格保持，antony 始终明显更高。

严控手部结构，每只手固定五指。禁止肢体扭曲、身体穿模、头发穿过身体。

全场只允许存在一颗正在使用的篮球（篮架柱子下靠着的那颗备用球全程不动，不得被拿起）。严禁篮球复制、凭空消失或在错误的位置出现。

篮球的位置必须全程逻辑自洽：0—6.5 秒在 antony 手中；6.5—7.5 秒飞向 manik；7.5—10.5 秒在 manik 掌中；10.5 秒之后一直在天空中，直到最后一帧仍未落地。

速度坡道只允许出现在 7 秒的接球与 14 秒的出拳这两个瞬间。绝不允许全片慢动作、绝不允许定格帧。

破坏与尘土必须由实际接触触发。禁止尘环脱离落点，禁止尘土早于动作出现。

台词为英文原声，成年男性嗓音，极低沉、平静、缓慢，带着一丝笑意。唇形自然同步。

【负面提示词】

台词超过一句，出现第二句台词，泰米尔语对白，印地语对白，反派说话，围观者说话，旁白，内心独白，念出动作描述文字，念出举止说明，念出运镜说明，字幕，Logo，UI，水印；

角色三视图，灰色摄影棚背景，白色背景，DETAILS & SWATCHES 细节格，色卡条，尺寸标注线，6ft 字样，7FT 字样，BAASHA 字样，HEIGHT 表格，FRONT VIEW 字样，图片原有文字；

写实照片风格，真人电影质感，3D 渲染，塑料质感，人物比例正常化，人物变矮变胖，失去线稿，失去手绘笔触，背景变成照片；

换脸，换装，manik 失去八字胡，manik 失去墨镜，antony 长出胡子，antony 有八字胡，墨镜提前脱落，球衣号码改变，786 变成其他数字，球衣配色漂移，人物复制，分身，第三名球员参战；

身高差消失，manik 比 antony 高，antony 变矮，两人等高；

英雄慌张，英雄躲闪，英雄后退，英雄大喊大叫，英雄愤怒，英雄用双手接球，英雄被球砸中脸，英雄移动脚步接球，接球失败，球从手中弹开；

反派大笑出声，反派咆哮，反派提前低头，反派躲开拳头，反派反击，反派获胜；

围观者进入球场，围观者加入冲突，围观者攻击，围观者消失得无影无踪，球场空无一人；

两颗篮球，篮球复制，篮球凭空消失，篮球在 10.5 秒后落地，篮球投进篮筐，篮球滚在地上，备用球被拿起；

彩色能量，发光特效，气功，火焰，雷电，激光，冲击波光效，游戏技能 UI，廉价粒子，速度线特效；

夜景，日落，雨天，雪地，室内体育馆，木地板球场，封闭场馆，明亮无阴影的照明，天空变阴，云消失，城市天际线消失；

prompt:
Mission: The Great Diamond Escape

Seedance 2.5 on @openart_ai

Prompt

16:9 landscape, ultra-realistic AAA third-person gameplay, bright afternoon at a luxurious Japanese train station. Realistic game-engine visuals, natural human animation, believable physics, detailed skin and hair, realistic clothing movement, marble reflections and cinematic daylight. Clearly a GAME, not anime or cartoon.

NAGI: Use @ Image1 as exact face and identity reference. Japanese high-school girl, 17, long straight black hair with blunt bangs, white sailor blouse with pink collar stripes and pink ribbon, grey pleated skirt, black knee-high socks, white sneakers and school bag. Same face, hair and outfit throughout.

MISSION: Steal a priceless diamond necklace from a VIP passenger's luxury suitcase and escape onto the departing train.

CAMERA: One physical third-person camera, 1.5m behind NAGI, slightly camera-right. Natural gameplay spring movement, smooth FOV breathing 30°–60°. Camera follows her continuously.

0–6s — INFILTRATION

NAGI moves through the crowded luxury station toward a VIP waiting area. A wealthy passenger sits beside a black suitcase guarded by two security guards. She hides briefly behind a luggage cart as a guard passes.

HUD:
MISSION: STEAL VIP NECKLACE
STEALTH MODE

6–12s — THEFT

NAGI reaches the suitcase while the VIP looks away. She opens it and finds a velvet jewelry case containing a stunning diamond necklace. She grabs it and hides it inside her bag.

HUD:
TARGET ACQUIRED

Suddenly a guard notices her.

ALERT

12–19s — FIGHT

The guard grabs NAGI's arm. She struggles hard to escape. He pulls her backward and she nearly falls. She pushes free and runs.

A second guard intercepts her. They struggle physically in a realistic, difficult fight. NAGI finally breaks away, visibly exhausted.

HUD:
NECKLACE ACQUIRED
ALERT LEVEL: CRITICAL

19–25s — CHASE

NAGI sprints toward the platform while two guards chase her. She jumps over luggage, turns sharply through a narrow passage and runs toward the departing luxury train.

Her hair, skirt and bag move naturally with her speed.

Station announcement:

“Train departing shortly.”

HUD:
ESCAPE ROUTE: PLATFORM 4

25–27s — LAST SECOND

The train doors begin closing.

A guard grabs NAGI's shoulder.

She struggles free and runs the final few meters.

She jumps into the train.

The doors close immediately behind her.

HUD:
ESCAPE SUCCESSFUL

27.0s HARD CUT

27–30s — FINAL SHOT

Locked frontal camera inside the moving luxury train, eye-level, 29° FOV, completely static.

NAGI stands in the aisle facing camera, breathing heavily, hair slightly messy.

She opens her bag and reveals the stolen diamond necklace.

Bright afternoon sunlight enters through the train windows.

HUD:

MISSION COMPLETE
DIAMOND SECURED
ESCAPE RANK: S

NAGI looks directly at camera and gives a tiny victorious smile.

AUDIO: tense stealth music, station ambience, footsteps, luggage wheels, security radio, realistic struggle sounds, fast breathing, train warning chime and a short victory sting.

ABSOLUTE LOCKS: Exactly one hard cut at 27s. First 27 seconds completely continuous. Same NAGI, same outfit, same necklace and same environment continuity. Realistic physics and difficult physical struggles. No superhuman movements, no cartoon animation, no face changes, no teleportation. Daytime only. HUD fixed in the same screen positions. All HUD text English; dialogue/announcements natural Japanese.

path: prompts/真人/现实向/剧情短片/goodcase-seedance-multi-shot-sequence-with-hard-cuts-between--红玩具鼠让女孩与病猫重获新生.md
prompt:
Multi-shot sequence with hard cuts between shots. Keep the same characters, cat, environments and visual style throughout. No music or score — only natural diegetic sound.
SHOT 1
A dirty, exhausted 18-year-old girl with dark auburn-brown hair in a messy low ponytail, warm brown eyes, faded olive-green military jacket, backpack and gloves, holds a bolt-action rifle inside an abandoned ornate mansion. Sweat, dirt, a cheek scrape and tears cover her face. Her hands tremble. She closes her eyes as a tear rolls down her cheek, then hears a faint sound and slowly lowers the rifle, visibly heartbroken.
SHOT 2
Over her shoulder, an infected golden-orange tabby cat sits weakly on the debris-covered parquet floor. Its fur is dirty and matted, eyes cloudy and pale, with small wounds and dark infected veins visible beneath its fur. The cat trembles and lets out a soft, frightened meow.
SHOT 3
She slowly crouches beside the cat, carefully places the rifle on the floor, wipes her tears and gives it a small broken smile. She quietly speaks to the cat in a gentle voice, reaches into her jacket and pulls out a small worn red toy mouse. She gently places it on the floor and nudges it toward the cat.
SHOT 4
Extreme low-angle close-up of the small red toy mouse sliding slowly through dust across the cracked parquet floor. It stops directly in front of the cat's paws. The cat looks down at it. Hold on the still toy and the cat's trembling paws.
HARD CUT / TRANSFORMATION
SHOT 5
Same low camera angle and exact toy position, but now on a clean sunny residential basketball court. A healthy golden-orange tabby cat suddenly reaches forward and grabs the toy mouse. Its eyes are clear and warm, fur clean and fluffy, movements energetic and playful. The cat bats the toy around excitedly.
SHOT 6
Wide shot of the basketball court. The woman gently tosses the toy mouse across the court. The happy cat runs after it, pounces on it, plays with it, then runs back toward her and drops the toy at her feet, ready to play again.
SHOT 7
Close-up of the clean, unharmed woman laughing warmly while affectionately scratching the cat behind its ears and gently rubbing its neck. The cat purrs, leans against her hand and happily flicks its tail.
SHOT 8
Wide peaceful shot. The woman and cat sit together beside a pristine dark-green vintage convertible parked beside the basketball court. She sits on the ground beside the car, opens a small tin of cat food and gently feeds the cat. The cat eats peacefully, then rubs its head against her hand. She smiles and gently strokes its back.
CONSISTENCY
Same woman throughout: dark auburn-brown hair, loose low ponytail, warm brown eyes, olive-green military jacket, khaki cargo pants and brown boots.
Same cat throughout: golden-orange tabby coat, distinctive facial markings, same eye shape, same body size and proportions. Infected, injured and frightened in the mansion; completely healthy, clean, playful and energetic after the transformation.
MANSION
Abandoned ornate interior, tall arched windows, torn dark-red curtains, peeling damask wallpaper, shattered gilt mirror, broken furniture, debris, ceiling hole and strong sunlight beams cutting through dusty air.
COURT
Clean residential basketball court, white lines, iron fence, flowering shrubs, stone townhouses, warm late-afternoon sunlight and soft natural shadows. Dark-green vintage convertible with chrome trim.
VISUAL STYLE
Ultra-realistic, photorealistic live-action, natural human and animal movement, handheld camera, shallow depth of field, ARRI Alexa 35 look, warm cinematic grade, subtle film grain. Hard cuts between shots. The transformation must feel instantaneous and visually seamless, with the toy mouse and camera position matching precisely across the cut.

Okay this feels straight out of GTA

Seedance 2.5 on @itsPolloAI

Prompt

Create a 30-second ultra-realistic AAA third-person medical action game mission set inside a modern Japanese hospital, with the feel of premium GTA-style gameplay.
NAGI: Use the exact same NAGI identity and face from @ Image1 throughout. Young Japanese female surgeon with long straight black hair, blunt bangs, blue surgical scrubs, cap, mask, gloves, and hospital shoes. Perfect character consistency.

TOP LEFT: NAGI / DOCTOR LV. 12
TOP CENTER: MISSION: SAVE THE PATIENT

She connects an IV and adjusts the patient's oxygen support. The monitor becomes slightly more stable.

NAGI runs to the preparation area, opens a medical cabinet, grabs a sterile surgical tray, receives another instrument from a nurse, and rushes back.
HUD: OBJECTIVE 3/5 — COLLECT SURGICAL TOOLS → OBJECTIVE COMPLETE

The monitor suddenly alarms and vital signs drop. NAGI immediately checks the monitor, adjusts support equipment, signals the team, and continues the procedure.

Jessica races through the open-office aisle, grabs a wheeled whiteboard, and pulls it diagonally across his path. He brakes before hitting it and immediately circles around. prompt:
One continuous video alley chase flows directly into the golden field reveal via a hard light-blowout transition. Sixteen shots, two locations, one unbroken timeline, screen-left-to-right travel maintained through both acts.
SCENE CONTEXT
A reanimated corpse in a ruined business suit pursues a sprinting woman down a shuttered warehouse service alley. She gains ground, he loses it on a toppled bin. At her breaking point she stops, turns, and faces him — and in a burst of blinding light she bolts past him out of the alley's open end into open golden grassland, and he is revealed as himself again, human, chasing not to catch her but to reach her. He catches up, she turns into him, and the piece ends in a still embrace. The two settings are physically distinct (alley → field); the transition is carried by a hard light-blowout cut, not a dissolve.
ACTIVE REFERENCES
<<<image_1>>> (LOCATION — ALLEY): roller shutter wall of horizontal pastel blue-grey slats crossed by one cobalt-blue stripe and one mustard-yellow stripe, rust bleeding down from bolt seams, a maroon plastic wheelie bin with a hinged lid standing against the shutter, a dark vertical steel support beam and a chipped yellow bollard pole at the right edge, cracked stained concrete underfoot. 100% matches the reference.
<<<image_2>>> (ZOMBIE — MAN, Act 1): adult male of Korean descent, ashen grey-green mottled skin, disheveled dark straight hair dulled with grey dust, grime-stiffened charcoal suit jacket torn at the left shoulder seam over a white dress shirt with rust-brown chest spatter and top buttons torn away, one clouded pale-blue eye and one bloodshot brown eye, deep dried laceration across the forehead above the right brow and a shorter one down the left cheek, cracked lips, jagged yellowed broken teeth, dried blood ringing the mouth and collar. 100% matches the reference.
<<<image_3>>> (HUMAN — MAN, Act 2 reveal): same Korean man, dark straight hair now clean and styled, warm skin tone restored, clean-shaven jaw with light stubble, navy tailored two-piece suit or navy blazer, white dress shirt, black leather derby shoes, silver wristwatch. No wounds, no grime, no blood.
<<<image_4>>> (WOMAN, both acts): Korean woman, dark hair parted center and worn loose over the shoulders, warm fair skin, cream ribbed knit zip-up cardigan over a white top, khaki/tan straight-leg trousers, off-white low-top sneakers. 100% matches the reference in Act 1; same wardrobe carries into Act 2.
<<<image_5>>> (LOCATION — FIELD): wide field of tall golden reeds swaying in the wind, low sun glowing near the horizon with soft warm lens flare, hazy mountain silhouette in the background. 100% matches the reference.
LOCATION MAP
Act 1: a single continuous alley running screen-left to screen-right, striped roller shutter as the full backing wall, maroon wheelie bin two-thirds down the run, steel beam and yellow bollard marking the open far end. Act 2: the alley's open end gives directly onto the reed field — she exits the alley mouth and is already running through grass on the far side of the light-blowout cut. Direction of travel stays screen-left to screen-right across both acts without exception.
FORMAT MODE
Sixteen shots across 30 seconds. Hard cuts unless a transition is specified. Shot 12 carries the one authored transition effect (light blowout) that bridges the two locations. Every cut is authored below — the camera does not cut on its own.
OPTICS
Anamorphic spherical hybrid, T2.3 equivalent, for the alley act. Field act shifts to a softer spherical look with warm flare artifacts. Focal lengths vary by shot as specified. Shallow depth of field on close and medium work throughout; deep focus only on the long-lens and wide shots as noted.
SHOT TIMELINE
SHOT 1 (00:00.0–00:01.6) — GROUND-LEVEL FEET
Camera locked off 20cm above the concrete, 24mm wide, square to the alley. Her off-white sneakers hammer through frame left to right at full sprint, kicking dust bursts off the concrete. Two beats later his scuffed grey-toed derby shoes drag through the same path, the left foot turning inward on each step. Rack focus from the near concrete grit to the receding legs. Cuts hard on his trailing foot leaving frame.
SHOT 2 (00:01.6–00:03.2) — OVER-SHOULDER CHASE CAM
Handheld at 1.5m directly behind her right shoulder, 35mm, pushing forward at her pace with a live 3cm vertical bounce on each footfall. Her loose dark hair whips back into the lens edge and separates into strands. The striped shutter wall streaks past on the left in horizontal blur. She snaps a look back over her shoulder and he enters the lower right of frame behind her, closer than expected. Exits on a fast whip pan left.
SHOT 3 (00:03.2–00:04.8) — REVERSE FACE DOLLY
Camera retreating ahead of her at 1.5m, 50mm, medium close-up front-on, matched exactly to her pace. Mouth open mid-scream, chest heaving, eyes flicking off-camera behind her. Six-degree dutch tilt on entry drifting back to level across the shot. The wall stripes converge and blur behind her head. Exits as her swinging hand crosses the lens and smears the frame.
SHOT 4 (00:04.8–00:06.2) — ZOMBIE LOW-ANGLE PUSH-IN
Camera low at 0.6m looking up, 40mm. He lurches directly toward lens, head lolling, jaw grinding, his right hand entering the top of frame reaching past camera. Digital scale-in punch of roughly fifteen percent stacked with a 4Hz handheld vibration. The clouded pale-blue eye catches the bounce light off the shutter slats and goes flat white for two frames. Cuts hard.
SHOT 5 (00:06.2–00:07.8) — WIDE LATERAL TWO-SHOT
Lateral tracking dolly at 1.6m, 32mm, full-figure wide, moving right at the runners' pace. Both figures in frame against the striped wall, gap holding at roughly one and a half strides. The maroon wheelie bin sits ahead in their path at the right of frame. No effects, no shake — the clean breathing shot of the piece. She breaks left around the bin as the shot ends.
SHOT 6 (00:07.8–00:09.0) — BIN ARC AND WIPE
Camera arcs thirty degrees around the wheelie bin at 1.2m, 28mm, as she cuts past it on the outside. The bin's maroon body sweeps into the foreground and fills the frame edge to edge in a soft-focus wipe. The next shot emerges out of the maroon as the bin clears.
SHOT 7 (00:09.0–00:11.2) — THE NEAR-MISS. SIGNATURE VISUAL EFFECT.
Speed drops to approximately twenty percent. High three-quarter angle at 2.2m looking down across her shoulder, 75mm, tight on the cream jacket's shoulder seam. His grey-green fingertips enter frame and graze the wool without gripping — the fabric compresses under the fingertips, then releases and springs back. Individual hair strands hang suspended in the air around her neck. Dust motes float motionless in the pale bounce light. Speed ramps smoothly back to one hundred percent across the final four frames as the fabric snaps free and her shoulder pulls away.
SHOT 8 (00:11.2–00:12.6) — BIN TOPPLES
High angle at 4m looking almost straight down, 24mm. He shoulder-checks the wheelie bin as he passes. The hinged lid flaps open, the bin tips, and it rolls across the concrete behind them trailing grit. Camera tilts down and drifts right, losing them at the bottom of frame. Cuts hard.
SHOT 9 (00:12.6–00:14.0) — LOOK-BACK SNAP
Handheld medium close-up at 1.6m, 50mm, snap-panning right to follow her head turn as she checks behind her. Heavy rolling-shutter smear across the pan. Her hair crosses her face and pulls clear. She registers the widening gap. The smear carries directly into the next frame.
SHOT 10 (00:14.0–00:15.6) — LONG LENS COMPRESSION
Static locked-off telephoto from far down the alley, 135mm, both figures small in frame and stacked against each other by the compression. The wall's horizontal stripes flatten into hard graphic bands. The gap between them is now visibly three strides, clearly wider than it was. Lowest energy point in the edit — no camera movement, no effects, deep haze.
SHOT 11 (00:15.6–00:17.2) — THE STUMBLE
Static low wide at 0.9m, 35mm. His lead foot catches the rolled bin. He pitches forward and drops onto one hand, palm scraping concrete, then hauls himself back up without his head ever leaving her — the eyes track her the whole way down and back. She is already at the right edge of frame, three strides clear and still accelerating.
SHOT 12 (00:17.2–00:19.5) — THE TURN AND THE BLOWOUT
She reaches the open mouth of the alley and, instead of running on, stops dead and turns to face him full-on — chest heaving, no longer fleeing. Camera holds level at 1.8m, 40mm, on the two of them squared off, the open daylight of the alley's end flaring hard behind her. He keeps closing. On his final stride the daylight behind her blooms into total white, overexposing outward from her silhouette until the frame is pure blown-out white for the final two frames. No dissolve — the white is a hard wall the alley disappears into.
SHOT 13 (00:19.5–00:21.5) — FIELD EMERGENCE
The white resolves directly into the reed field, mid-motion, no fade. Wide shot, low sun glowing behind the subjects with soft warm lens flare, hazy mountain silhouette in the background. She is already running left to right through tall golden reeds, laughing now instead of screaming, glancing back over her shoulder. The man — now fully human, clean, in a navy blazer — runs behind her, reaching one arm toward her with a joyful smile. Side-tracking camera at chest height, warm backlight, shallow depth of field, romantic cinematic color grade.
SHOT 14 (00:21.5–00:24.0) — SIDE-TRACKING RUN
Camera closer now, continuing the side-track through the reed field. She laughs brightly, hair blowing in the wind; he reaches his hand further toward her, both fully smiling, sun flare intensifying as they move through a patch of brighter backlight. Warm glowing atmosphere, soft golden bokeh, smooth tracking camera motion, no cuts within the shot.
SHOT 15 (00:24.0–00:27.0) — THE CATCH AND TURN
Camera holds at 1.6m, 65mm, as he finally reaches her — his outstretched hand meets hers or her arm, and instead of a struggle it becomes a pull-in: she turns into him mid-stride, momentum carrying them into a stumbling half-spin that settles into an embrace, both slightly out of breath, both laughing. Eye contact held for a full beat before her face tips into his shoulder — lashes wet, laughing through what reads as both relief and joy. Warm rim light separates both figures from the golden grass behind them. Slow 4% push-in across the shot.
SHOT 16 (00:27.0–00:30.0) — WIDE RESOLUTION
Camera pulls back to 3m, 32mm, wide two-shot of the embrace standing still in the swaying grass, low sun and mountain silhouette centered behind them, lens flare soft across the upper frame. Neither figure moves except gentle breathing, the wind through the grass, and her hand resting on his back. Grain settles. Frame is still when it ends.
PERFORMANCE
Woman (Act 1): brows drawn tight, eyes wide and wet with catch-light, jaw dropped in a raw open scream, neck tendons standing with each gasp, chin driving forward on the acceleration beats. Woman (Act 2): the same fear releases into breathless laughter and open relief the instant she crosses into the field.
Zombie (Act 1): jaw hanging slack and grinding, broken teeth bared through split lips, the clouded eye fixed and unblinking while the bloodshot eye tracks her continuously, guttural throat movement on each lunge, no facial expression beyond the mechanical. Man (Act 2): warm, open, smiling, fully human — no trace of the mechanical carried over.
PHYSICS
Feet strike concrete with visible dust puffs on every footfall in Act 1; in Act 2 feet part the reeds with a soft rustle and no dust. Her cream jacket snaps and flares with each stride throughout both acts, the open zip flapping. Her loose hair separates into distinct strands and trails behind her head, never tying or clumping. In Act 1 his suit jacket flaps stiff and heavy, the torn shoulder seam gaping wider as he runs, and dried blood on his collar stays static and matte — no new blood, no fresh spatter. In Act 2 his navy blazer moves naturally with his stride, unmarked. The wheelie bin has real plastic weight when struck, the lid hinging loose, the roll decelerating naturally across the concrete.
LIGHTING
Act 1: low cool ambient at 4200K, no direct key, both faces lit by bounce off the pale shutter slats, faint cobalt and mustard color spill from the painted stripes, subjects slightly backlit at the rim throughout, heaviest haze at Shot 10. Act 2: warm low-sun backlight at roughly 3200K, strong practical lens flare, soft golden ambient fill, no cool tones remaining anywhere in frame.
COLOR GRADE
Act 1: desaturated teal-cyan base pulled from the blue-grey slats, the mustard stripe and maroon bin plastic the only warm accents, blacks retained rather than crushed. The Shot 12 blowout carries the grade from cool to a clipped, textureless white. Act 2: grade flips to warm amber and gold, gentle highlight bloom, soft filmic contrast, no crushed blacks.
WARDROBE
Zombie / Man: Act 1 — charcoal wool suit jacket stiff with grime and grey dust, torn open at the left shoulder seam, white dress shirt with rust-brown spatter across the chest and right shoulder, top three buttons torn away, collar askew, dust-caked trousers, grey-scuffed black derby shoes. Act 2 — navy blazer, white dress shirt, clean and unmarked, same build and facial identity as Act 1 minus the wounds and grime.
Woman: cream wool-blend zip jacket with the zip open to mid-chest and the collar flaring with motion, white ribbed top underneath, tan straight-leg trousers, off-white low sneakers, long dark hair worn loose and untied throughout both acts.
AUDIO
Act 1: ragged panicked breathing building to a scream; low guttural groaning on each of his lunges; two distinct sets of footfalls on concrete, hers light and fast, his heavy and uneven; the hollow plastic clatter and roll of the toppled bin; a faint metallic resonance off the shutter door. Shot 12: the ambient sound drops out under the white blowout. Act 2: wind moving through reeds, her breathless laughter, both sets of footfalls softened on grass, no dialogue, near silence under the final still embrace.
STYLE
Photoreal cinematic horror-thriller shifting into romantic drama. Fine 35mm-style grain throughout, pore-level naturalistic skin detail on both faces, practical prosthetic makeup register on the zombie rather than digital creature rendering in Act 1. No stylization beyond the color grade in either act.
OUTPUT SETTINGS
16:9, 24 fps, 30 seconds total. Real-time speed throughout except the specified slow-motion ramp in Shot 7.
POSITIVE LOCKS
<<<image_2>>>/<<<image_3>>> and <<<image_4>>> identities, wardrobe, and (in Act 1) wound placement stay 100% consistent with their references in every frame. The man's facial identity is continuous across the wound/no-wound transition — same bone structure, same hairline — only the condition of the skin and wardrobe changes at the blowout. Her hair stays loose and untied throughout both acts, never tied back. Direction of travel is screen-left to screen-right in every shot without exception across both locations. The gap between them narrows through Shot 7 and widens from Shot 8 through Shot 11 before closing again in the field act. His hand grazes the jacket in Shot 7 and never achieves a grip until the intentional catch in Shot 15. The white blowout in Shot 12 is the only location transition in the piece — no other dissolves or fades occur. Cuts occur only at the sixteen specified timestamps and nowhere else.

prompt:
⤵️
SCENE 1 (0:00–0:30) — MONOCHROME STUDIO → FULL RITUAL → EMERALD GOWN → LAST DETAIL
SHOT STRUCTURE: 15 shots, 30 seconds, 16:9
@Image1 is the Aiko character reference — keep her face, fair skin, sleek black bob haircut and dark-brown eyes identical in every shot.
GLOBAL STYLE NOTES:
lighting_philosophy: crisp white beauty-dish key on her face, cool silver glow from square-framed vanity mirrors behind, soft grey practicals on walls; glossy speculars on marble, chrome and glass.
color_grade: high-gloss monochrome beauty commercial — charcoal-grey walls, ivory marble, fair skin held clean and cool; the emerald gown is the only deep saturated green in the film.
setting: sleek minimalist glam studio — charcoal-grey walls, polished ivory marble floor, low velvet stools in ash-grey, white sheepskin rugs, three large square chrome-framed vanity mirrors, a thin white LED strip along the ceiling, beauty-dish lights on stands, a disco ball throwing slow silver dots across the marble, open shelves of matte black labelled bottles and jars, a single orchid in a glass vase, a chrome drinks cart.
staff: three women in charcoal uniforms — an esthetician, a make-up artist, a hair stylist. Shown mainly as hands, forearms, backs and soft-focus bodies. No close-ups of their faces except the final reaction in medium shot. They move fast and react openly.
mirror_rule: mirrors stay BEHIND or BESIDE her, soft-focus, as light and texture only. Never a sharp reflection of her face shown next to her actual face in the same frame.
characters:
Aiko: visual_anchors: petite elegant build, sleek jet-black bob haircut with blunt bangs, dark-brown eyes, fair even skin, a small mole near one eye. Opens in a plain white ribbed tank top. Performance: composed, quietly amused — one mouth corner lifts, never a wide expression. She is the only still person in a room full of motion.
ambience: glossy pop beat locked to every cut, studio chatter under it, hairdryer hum. Beat drops at shot 12, cuts to silence at shot 15.
SEQUENCE LIST:
SHOT 1 (0–2s) HOOK — WS, glass door
camera_motion: static, then fast push-in
action_visual: Aiko (per @Image1) pushes the glass door open in a plain white tank top — cool silver light floods the frame. Door chime, beat starts on her step
exit: she walks past camera into the studio
SHOT 2 (2–4s) SETUP — MS tracking
camera_motion: handheld tracking behind her through the studio, chrome mirrors and shelves streaking past
action_visual: she drops into an ash-grey velvet stool. The esthetician snaps a white cape open and clicks it shut at her neck. A long emerald evening gown hangs soft-focus behind her; black leather ankle boots sit under the stool
exit: hands enter frame toward her face
SHOT 3 (4–6s) — insert macro on hands
camera_motion: static macro, 85mm
action_visual: a pump bottle pushes white cleansing foam into a gloved palm; gloved hands work the foam up her cheeks in one upward sweep. Wet foam squelch, pump hiss
exit: water enters frame
SHOT 4 (6–8s) — MCU
camera_motion: static, slight handheld float
action_visual: water rinses the foam, she lifts her wet face and droplets fly sideways catching the beauty-dish light
exit: a brush enters frame from the left
SHOT 5 (8–10s) SIGNATURE — MCU, frontal
vfx: none. Speed 100%
camera_motion: locked frontal, composition does not shift
action_visual: a brush lays charcoal clay mask in three strokes → jump to the mask already dry. She raises ONE eyebrow, the crust cracks across the bridge of her nose. The esthetician freezes mid-air with the brush. Aiko lowers the brow back
exit: two gel patches click under her eyes
SHOT 6 (10–12s) — MCU, frontal, same framing
camera_motion: locked, no movement
action_visual: the make-up artist slams a large powder puff straight into the lens, frame goes soft white → clears on glowing porcelain make-up and satin lips
exit: a brush sweeps across frame
SHOT 7 (12–14s) — MCU, same framing
camera_motion: locked
action_visual: the brush clears to reveal a sharp graphic black cat-eye liner and pale lips → a palm sweeps down the frame → clears on deep bronze eyelids
exit: the powder puff slams into the lens again
SHOT 8 (14–16s) — MCU, same framing
camera_motion: locked, tiny push-in
action_visual: frame clears on full smoky bronze eye, subtle highlighter on the cheekbones, deep berry-red lipstick. The make-up artist steps back and raises both hands. Aiko holds still half a second. Lipstick cap clicks
exit: a towel is pulled off her head
SHOT 9 (16–18s) — MS
camera_motion: static, then whip pan out and back
action_visual: the stylist rips the towel away, wet hair drops in one sheet → whip pan returns on a sleek glossy black bob shining under the beauty-dish light
exit: a flat iron enters frame
SHOT 10 (18–19s) — insert macro
vfx: speed ramp 50%→100%
camera_motion: static macro, 50mm
action_visual: the flat iron clicks open and releases a glossy sheet of hair, steam rises into the light beam
exit: steam crosses the lens
SHOT 11 (19–21s) — MS
camera_motion: two fast whip pans, out and back each time
action_visual: hair pushed back loose, the stylist tucks it behind her ear → whip pan → sleek blunt-bangs bob with a sharp edge. Aiko tips her head, hair swings across frame
exit: hair fills frame
SHOT 12 (21–24s) CLIMAX — MS to WS, studio floor
camera_motion: static, then slow pull-back
action_visual: the stylist lifts the emerald gown off a chrome hanger, the fabric flies across the whole frame — deep emerald floods the screen — then falls away: Aiko stands in the middle of the studio in a long emerald silk evening gown, bob restored, silk running to the floor. Silk whoosh, heavy fabric fall
exit: fingers rise to her ear
SHOT 13 (24–26s) — insert macro on ear
camera_motion: static macro, 85mm
action_visual: the make-up artist's fingers fasten a small emerald drop earring at her ear. The clasp click lands as the beat drop
exit: camera pulls wide
SHOT 14 (26–28s) — WS full length
camera_motion: static wide, three staff visible either side of her
action_visual: Aiko glances aside, takes two steps to the stool and bends down. Low insert: the emerald silk hem lifts and black leather ankle boots enter frame — one foot, then the other
exit: she straightens up
SHOT 15 (28–30s) PUNCHLINE — WS full length
camera_motion: locked off, no movement
action_visual: she straightens, adjusts the hem so the ankle boots stay visible, and looks straight into the lens. All three staff freeze. The stylist drops a brush — it clatters on the marble. One mouth corner lifts. She walks out of frame. Beat cuts to silence on the clatter
exit: empty studio, three women looking after her, brush on the floor. Hold one second, end
GENERATE FIRST: Shot 5 (eyebrow cracks the mask — the tone-setter), Shot 12 (emerald gown fabric wipe), Shot 15 (ankle boots punchline).

path: prompts/真人/特效向/动作大片/goodcase-seedance-some-goodbyes-are-harder-than-war-itself-0--朝鲜王朝城门前的离别之吻.md
prompt:
Some goodbyes are harder than war itself. 🥹❤️

One last embrace. One last kiss.
And a promise to come home. 🏮

🎥 Powered by Seedance 2.5 in @YouArtStudio
#kdrama #YouArtCPP #YouArt

Prompt 👇

Character & Scene Image References (TAGGED — bind each tag to its reference image)
Husband = soldier husband sheet (black sangtu + manggeon, dark navy Joseon military jeogori/baji, quilted dark vest with crossed straps, mid-calf leather boots, sheathed hwando on left hip, lean athletic build, steadfast tender face). Use Husband for every shot of the husband.
Wife = wife sheet (jjokjin meori with wooden binyeo, cream/ivory jeogori, dusty rose chima, white beoseon + traditional shoes, tear-bright eyes, soft aching face). Use Wife for every shot of the wife.
Gate = Joseon hanok gate plate (partially open dark wooden daemun under tiled eaves, stone-mud wall, packed-earth threshold, dim interior corridor with warm lantern glow, cool dawn/blue-hour exterior). Use Gate as locked geography for all shots.

Scene Geography (immutable · Gate)
Kiss and farewell happen at the threshold of Gate: Husband stands on the courtyard/outside side ready to leave toward the road; Wife stands at the open door leaf turning toward the warm interior. Hand-grab and lip kiss happen just outside under the eaves. No second location, no battlefield cutaway.

KEY PROP (HARD LOCK)
PROP-SWORD: one sheathed hwando on Husband's LEFT hip — black scabbard with muted gold fitting, secured by the same dark sash. Visible in wide/medium shots; never swaps sides, never disappears, never becomes a different weapon.
PROP-HAND: when he grabs her, it is her RIGHT wrist/hand; contact continuity must match across cuts.

Immutable Character Facts
Husband: late-20s Joseon soldier; restrained love; pulls her back into a passionate but still sageuk-restrained lip kiss.
Wife: mid-20s wife; tearful, brave; forehead kiss first; vows she will wait at this door every day.

Dramatic Goal
Dawn goodbye that breaks open: soft vow → forehead kiss → she turns inside → he grabs her hand → passionate Korean-style lip kiss. Relationship shift = love spoken through body more than words.

Continuous Timeline (30s)
0–4s — Status quo: cool dawn at Gate; Husband stands outside in full travel kit, PROP-SWORD on left hip; Wife at the open threshold, teary, hands lightly on his chest/sleeves.
4–10s — First probe / vow: Wife, soft Korean through tears: 「부디 무사히… 어서 돌아오세요. 매일 이 문 앞에서 기다릴게요.」 He listens, jaw tight, eyes wet but controlled.
10–16s — Forehead kiss + turn: She hugs him, rises on toes, presses a tender forehead kiss (lips to his forehead / brow — not the mouth yet). Teary eyes. She releases, turns toward the warm interior of Gate, one step inside.
16–23s — Pull-back escalation: Husband's hand shoots out, grabs her RIGHT wrist/hand, pulls her back across the threshold into him. Breath hitch. Bodies close under the eaves of Gate.
23–27s — Passionate Korean lip kiss: He cups her face / waist; they kiss on the lips — deep, aching, sageuk-passionate (closed-to-soft-open mouth, lingering press, micro head tilt, tear-salt emotion) — NOT Western over-the-top making-out, NOT comedy, NO tongue spectacle. Hold on eyes half-closed, fingers clutching fabric.
27–30s — Resonant outro: Kiss breaks to a forehead rest / shared breath; her teary eyes; his thumb brushes her cheek; PROP-SWORD still on his left hip; hold on their profiles against Gate as dawn wind moves her chima.

Korean Dialogue (verbatim)
Wife: 「부디 무사히… 어서 돌아오세요. 매일 이 문 앞에서 기다릴게요.」
(Optional soft underspoken from Husband only if needed, otherwise silence after her line): 「기다리면… 꼭 올게.」

Micro-expressions & Performance
Notice → Process → Suppress → Leak → Act.
Prefer: tear sheen without ugly-cry collapse, eyelid tremble, breath catch, sleeve clutch, wrist grab impact, kiss linger, after-kiss forehead rest.
Emotion is adult married love — tender then urgent — never juvenile.

Camera Workflow
Wide establish Gate dawn → medium two-shot vow → close on her teary eyes → forehead-kiss insert → her turn inward → whip-soft reverse as he grabs her hand → tight two-shot lip kiss → extreme close lips/eyes briefly → lingering profile hold. Let silence carry the kiss. No modern handheld chaos, no whip-pan spam.

Sound
Quiet dawn sageuk ambient at Gate: distant birds, soft wind, wood gate creak, cloth rustle, breath, a single distant rooster optional. Dialogue and kiss breath above any score. If score, low gayageum/strings under the kiss only — never melodrama stings.

Hard Prohibitions
NO English/Chinese dialogue placeholders. NO modern props/phones/zippers. NO PROP-SWORD side-swap or weapon morph. NO identity drift from Husband or Wife. NO Gate layout change. NO second location. NO explicit sexual content beyond a passionate sageuk lip kiss. NO cartoon crying / screaming / wide-open mouth comedy. NO burned-in subtitles/text/watermark. NO plastic wax skin. NO filler past the kiss hold.

prompt:

缘一 VS 百鬼  ⚔️💥
纯粹的战斗爽感！

Seedance 2.5
Prompt 🔽

【基础设定】

30秒，16:9。暗色幻想绘画动画风格，粗粝厚涂笔触、硬边明暗、概括色块、清晰人物剪影。

人物、敌群、建筑、武器统一为具有立体空间感的绘画动画。

高速运动中保持人物、刀锋、命中位置清楚。

头发、衣摆、碎木、灰烬具有真实惯性与重量。

整体色调以墨黑、灰青、旧木褐为主，人物暗红服装作为主要识别色。

【参考图绑定】
图片1= 战场建筑与空间结构参考。
仅采用悬空木平台、栏杆、回廊、阶梯、大殿及上下交错建筑关系。
图片2 = 敌群外观参考。
提取不同体型、皮肤、眼睛、獠牙、长爪、破旧衣物与异化轮廓，扩展为高密度敌潮。
图片3= 主角唯一身份与服装参考。
锁定脸型、长发、暗红外衣、敞领、腰带、宽裤、绑腿与鞋履。

【角色规则】

全片始终只有一名主角。
始终使用同一把实体刀，刀鞘固定腰侧。

右手主握，重斩时左手辅助同一刀柄。

人物面部克制，视线始终寻找下一处敌阵缺口。

所有攻击必须由真实身体动作驱动：

蹬地 → 转髋 → 挥刀 → 回腕 → 连续落步。

高速移动过程中人物本体始终连续可追踪。

禁止瞬移。

禁止实体分身。

禁止第二把刀。

【敌群规则】

敌人数百只。

中央平台、两侧回廊、远端阶梯与建筑阴影始终存在大量敌人。

前景使用肩背、头部、爪子压住画面边缘。

中景多排敌人包围人物移动路线。

背景敌群一直延伸至建筑深处。

敌人必须持续：

扑入、夹击、绕侧、封路、补位。

人物移动到哪里，新的敌群就从前方与侧翼压入。

人物经过之后才允许留下局部缺口。

24秒之前禁止大面积清空战场。

【核心战斗逻辑】

模式：

流光割草 + 极限连招密度。

全片以：

高速穿群
移动旋斩
横扫
反手斩
斜劈
短跃下劈

作为主要动作。

目标约26组短连招。

每组动作必须：

起手 → 接招 → 收招，无缝连接。

上一刀的收刀方向，直接成为下一组攻击的起始方向。

禁止攻击后站住重新摆姿势。

禁止三刀打一组然后停顿。

人物始终边打边移动。
【空间规则】
主平台远端阶梯 = 北。
入口 = 南。
左右两侧分别为东、西。
人物移动路线：

南部
→ 东侧
→ 中央
→ 西侧
→ 北部。

摄影机始终朝向尚未清除的敌群推进。

人物身前必须持续存在新的敌阵。

身后逐渐形成已经战斗过的路径。

空间、建筑地标、人物方向必须保持连续。

【镜头结构】

全片10个镜头段。

每段约3秒。

Shot 1｜0–3s

Wide，高位斜俯视追踪。

人物直接高速切入右侧敌群。

突入横斩
→ 反手回切
→ 移动回旋
→ 再次斜切进入下一排。

没有登场。

没有拔刀。

没有蓄力。
第一秒直接进入战斗。
Shot 2｜3–6s
FS，贴地侧前跟拍。
人物沿东侧战区高速向北推进。

连续横扫、反手斩、斜劈。

敌人从正面和侧面不断补入。

摄影机倒退跟拍，同时保留前方大量敌群。

Shot 3｜6–9s

Wide，升高斜俯视追踪。

人物从东侧切向平台中央。

连续三组移动旋斩。

每一次旋转都改变人物所在位置。

禁止原地转圈。

镜头展示人物身后逐渐形成的战斗路线。

Shot 4｜9–12s

FS，低位跟进。
人物进入中央最密集敌阵。
横扫
→ 反撩
→ 斜切
→ 上挑
→ 踏进压斩
→ 短跃下劈。
上层回廊与地面敌人同时压入。

人物必须同时应对上下两个方向。

Shot 5｜12–15s

FS，侧面短弧环绕。

人物折向西侧。

移动旋斩
→ 短跃
→ 下劈
→ 落地反手横扫。

完成后立即进入下一群敌人。

禁止落地停顿。

Shot 6｜15–18s

Wide，斜俯视折返追踪。

人物切进西侧敌阵后向北折返。

连续横斩、反斩、回旋压斩。

新的敌群从西侧回廊持续补入。

北侧阶梯始终作为远处空间地标。

Shot 7｜18–21s

MS → FS。

先短暂靠近人物。

展示一次真实的近距离攻防：

敌人双爪封路。

人物低身闪开攻击，同时转髋反切。

随后镜头立即拉开。

继续展示范围穿群动作。

禁止变成单挑。

Shot 8｜21–24s

Wide。
人物进入北部中央区域。
沿敌潮内部连续折线移动。
斜切进入
→ 回旋扫开
→ 反手穿出
→ 再改变方向。
东西两侧残余敌群继续向中心补位。
Shot 9｜24–27s

FS → Wide。

人物切入最后的大规模密集敌阵。

横扫
→ 反手斩
→ 压斩
→ 回旋
→ 反撩
→ 前冲斜劈。

镜头逐渐拉开。

明确展示人物已经打通的路线，与前方最后敌阵的位置。

Shot 10｜27–30s

FS → Wide。
人物冲入北阶前最后一批敌人。
27–28秒完成最后一组连续攻击。
28秒后停止攻击。

刀尖自然随收势垂下。

镜头缓慢后拉。

展示整个已经清理完成的平台。

主角成为画面中唯一站立的人物。

衣摆、长发、灰烬、碎屑继续自然运动。

【摄影规则】

摄影机必须跟随：

人物移动路线
攻击方向
敌群变化
空间地标。

远景与全景负责展示敌潮规模。

中近景只用于短暂展示身体动作与刀锋。

禁止长期贴脸。

禁止把范围战斗拍成逐个单挑。

禁止依靠疯狂切镜制造速度。

速度必须来自：

人物移动
敌群运动
身体动作
前景掠过
摄影机追踪。

【声音】

No dialogue.

No battle cries.

No subtitles.

No background music.

保留：
脚步声
挥刀声
撞击声
木构破裂声
环境空间回响。

Above her the entire city hangs upside down, mirrored — a man in a bowler hat walks a dachshund across the inverted street. A red umbrella drifts weightlessly between the two worlds. 3–6s: Camera follows behind her into a narrow Venetian alley, dry leaves swirling in her wake. At the far end the street peels upward into the sky, buildings stacking vertically like a wall of windows. Her footsteps echo between the stone walls.
6–9s: The camera slowly rolls 90 degrees. The alley wall becomes the ground beneath her feet; she keeps running, unfazed. The roll continues into a wide orbit as she races up a floating spiral stone staircase suspended in mid-air, fragments of terracotta Venetian rooftops rotating around her like a kaleidoscope.
9–12s: Extreme wide silhouette. She runs across the top of an arched stone bridge over a wide canal against the blazing setting sun. The mirrored city hangs both above and below the arch. On the inverted plane, a lone pedestrian walks the opposite direction. Birds burst across the frame in slow motion.
12–15s: Low angle looking straight up between two towering building walls, the sky a thin bright strip. She leaps across the vertical chasm, arms spread wide, coat and hair flying, satchel swinging. Camera holds on her against the sky. Wind roars.
15–18s: Handheld push-in through a crowded 1940s Rialto market street — vendors stacking crates of apples, laundry strung overhead between the buildings. She weaves between blurred foreground shoppers, running away from camera. An apple rolls loose across the cobblestones.
18–21s: Camera tilts up a grand brick bell tower — a Venetian campanile — as the surrounding city folds and curls around it. The woman appears tiny on the tower ledge, pauses against the sun, then steps off toward the rooftops. Bells begin to ring.
21–24s: Rooftop terrace garden framed by a rose-covered arbor. An elderly woman in a grey cardigan waters a bed of vivid flowers with a tin can. Behind her, Venice and the domes of St Mark's Basilica glow at sunset over the lagoon while the inverted city hangs overhead. The young woman balances along the stone balustrade, arms out, then jumps down onto the terrace.
24–27s: She holds out the yellow envelope. The old woman turns, sets down the watering can, and takes it. Both smile warmly at each other. Rose petals drift upward past them, falling toward the inverted sky.
27–30s: Camera pulls back and rises fast. The whole city folds and rotates until it becomes a top-down aerial of Venice's canals and streets curling into a sphere. The two tiny figures remain on the terrace. Slow fade to warm light.
